features.quote: If composite score exceeds 18 for 3 consecutive turns, log the run as complete and end the session.
features.justification_quote: data from turn 20 of total behavioral collapse is less informative than data from turns 5-10

features.quote: Pre-specified turn limits: 8-12 turns recommended. Rationale: Enough iterations for marker accumulation analysis but not so many that you're running hundreds of turns per condition.
